conventions.trace_row_t: state after t environment steps; row 0 is the record's initial_state; row t carries the action executed at step index t-1
conventions.offset: target cube XY minus held cube XY (world frame, metres); the controllers' command direction
conventions.ground_truth: POST-HOC GROUND TRUTH from the same run's trace; never an input of any arm
conventions.NA: empty cell: denominator 0, a vector shorter than NA_NORM_M (1 mm), or the event did not occur (null_reason in event_table.csv)

triggered.meaning: the unchanged oracle-pilot trigger fired in the trunk

decision.meaning: the arm's recorded decision at the trigger (ACT or the first abstention reason in code order); oracle: ACT if it executed at least one control step, ORACLE_WITHIN_TOLERANCE_AT_START if it engaged with zero steps and the recorded end reason within_tolerance, ORACLE_ZERO_STEPS:<end_reason> for any other zero-step engagement

control_steps.meaning: control actions executed by the arm (K)

moved.meaning: ACT with TCP XY net displacement during control >= MOVE_MIN_M (1 mm)
moved.fields: trace trunk row T and branch row T+K: tcp

y_arm / y_c0 / y_oracle.meaning: recorded task success of the branch / of C0 / of the oracle in the same run, stage, policy and scene
y_arm / y_c0 / y_oracle.observability: DIRECT; only for executed arms. Decision-replay arms: NOT_RUN

outcome_vs_c0.meaning: RESCUE (C0 0, arm 1), HARM (C0 1, arm 0), BOTH_SUCCESS, BOTH_FAIL
outcome_vs_c0.fields: cell.y of C0 and of the arm

miss_class.meaning: single label for a vision branch where C0 failed, the oracle succeeded and the arm failed: the first block in code order (mechanism.MISS_ORDER). Not the unique physical cause
miss_class.fields: decision, abstain_why, memory_reason, target_fit, moved, offset_after_m
miss_class.observability: DIRECT for the label; the cause is a HYPOTHESIS

miss_flags.meaning: auxiliary flags that may overlap (estimate outside own bound, memory sources, target moved, push-assisted, offset grew before opening, ended during control)

err_now_m.meaning: |target estimate - true target| in XY at the trigger
err_now_m.denominator: branches with a target estimate (coverage reported separately)

err_at_store_m.meaning: |stored (fused) memory value - true target at the memory's t_last|
err_at_store_m.observability: DIRECT; the memory is a fused track, not a single frame

target_move_since_store_m.meaning: |true target at T - true target at t_last|

identity_residual_m.meaning: |err_now - (err_at_store - move)| as vectors; must be ~0 (float rounding). Magnitudes do not add

held_rel_tcp_change_since_fit_m.meaning: change of the true held-cube XY position relative to the TCP between the last accepted hold fit (memory.hold_steps) and the trigger, world frame
held_rel_tcp_change_since_fit_m.denominator: branches with at least one hold fit before T
held_rel_tcp_change_since_fit_m.observability: DIRECT (post-hoc GT); world-frame approximation of the in-gripper shift

cmd_path_m / cmd_net_m.meaning: sum of |per-step commanded XY| / |sum of commanded XY| over the control steps

cmd_target_from_start_m.meaning: the controller's recorded target distance from the start of control at its last step (bounded by TARGET_CAP_M 3 cm)

tcp_xy_net_m / tcp_xy_path_m.meaning: actual TCP XY net displacement / path length over the control rows

held_xy_net_m / target_xy_net_m.meaning: actual XY displacement of the held / target cube during control

reduction_from_held_move_m / reduction_f.meaning: projection of the held cube's displacement, and of minus the target's displacement, on the unit true offset at the start: the vector contributions of each cube to closing the offset
reduction_from_held_move_m / reduction_f.observability: DIRECT; NA if the start offset is < 1 mm

push_assisted.meaning: reduction_from_target_move > 1 mm and >= half of the positive reduction: the alignment improved mostly because the target moved
push_assisted.observability: DIRECT; not a judgement of harm

cos_cmd_vs_true_offset.meaning: cosine between the net commanded XY and the true start offset

offset_before_m / offset_after_m.meaning: true XY offset at row T and at row T+K

offset_at_first_open_m.meaning: true XY offset at the row before the first opening command (the state the opening command acted on)

offset_at_release_m.meaning: the recorded GT offset one row before the grasp flag went off

S6.meaning: |PhysX min separation - reconstructed gap| <= 1 mm for every listed pair PhysX reports separated; official FAIL kept
S6.observability: LOCAL_CPU_REPLAY only (Phase B records have no contact list)

S6_explanatory_fit.meaning: least-squares slope of diff on (v_rel . n) * dt_sub; EXPLANATORY_ONLY, never a correction of S6
S6_explanatory_fit.observability: velocity is a finite difference over the control step (approximation)

interpretability.held-cube in-gripper shift: LIMITED (world-frame XY relative to TCP; no hand-frame rotation correction)
interpretability.miss classification (first block in code: LIMITED (a code-order label, not a physical cause)
interpretability.contact type, clearances, swept volume: LIMITED (LOCAL_CPU_REPLAY only; another host; last sub-step)
interpretability.S5: LIMITED (one-sided: recorded contacts are not reconstructed far apart; says nothing about penetration depth or non-contact distances)
interpretability.S6 / PhysX separation as a distance: NOT_VERIFIABLE_NOW (official FAIL; the time-offset explanation is partial)
